query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS audit_time, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.auditor_node_id') AS node_id, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.auditor_locagram') AS locagram, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.health_score') AS INTEGER) AS compliance_score, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.runtime_log_level') AS log_level, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.schema_marine_registered') AS schema_ok, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.audit_summary') AS summary FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'MeshTopologyInspection' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 30

WITH RankedAudits AS (SELECT json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.auditor_node_id') AS node_id, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.health_score') AS INTEGER) AS score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.auditor_node_id') ORDER BY "$when" DESC) as rn FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'MeshTopologyInspection') SELECT node_id AS Monitored_Node, score AS Health_Score FROM RankedAudits WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY score ASC
